email_confirmation.subject: Confirm your email
email_confirmation.intro: Confirm your email address to activate your access.

password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset your account password.

user_change_request.subject: Review a change to your account
user_change_request.intro: Another administrator requested changes to your account details. Nothing changes until you approve the request.

email_change_notice.subject: Your account email was changed
email_change_notice.intro: The email address used to sign in to your account was just changed, and every session was signed out.
email_change_notice.warning: If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately.
